benefits.title: AI captions
benefits.desc: Describe the post in plain language. VOIS writes a caption that matches your brand voice, adds hashtags, and suggests the best posting time.

benefits.title: Visual scheduler
benefits.desc: See your content calendar at a glance. Drag posts to reschedule. Preview how your grid will look before publishing.

benefits.title: Performance metrics
benefits.desc: Track reach, engagement, and follower growth. See which content types perform best without leaving VOIS.

scenario: You snap a photo of a finished kitchen renovation. You say "post this with a caption about the transformation." VOIS generates three caption options, suggests posting Thursday at 11 am based on your engagement history, and schedules it. You approve from the car.
